packages.name: ChipDocs — Free KiCad Footprints, Symbols & 3D STEP
packages.description: Search 7,900+ IPC-7351B electronic components on chipdocs.org and install KiCad footprints (.kicad_mod), schematic symbols (.kicad_sym) & 3D STEP models directly into your project.
packages.description_full: ChipDocs Open-Hardware Library Plugin connects KiCad 7/8/9 directly to chipdocs.org (CERN-OHL-P-2.0). Search components by MPN, find pin-compatible replacements, and download verified IPC-7351B footprints (with 60% windowed EPAD paste grids), IEEE-315 symbols, and parametric 3D STEP AP214 models into your active KiCad project folder with one click.
